description_en: Retrieves the audio files of shared speech corpora
description_zh: 调用该接口获取共享语料的语音文件
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-share-speech-model-audio --share-task-id Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --speech-model-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetShareSpeechModelAudio

parameters.help_en:
The **task ID** of the sharing task.

You can obtain the **task ID** on the **Shared Corpus Management** page in the **Voice Broadcast Service** console
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的**任务ID**。

您可在**千里传音语音播报服务**控制台的**分享语料管理**页面，获取**任务ID**
parameters.name: share_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of **speech corpus identifiers** for the shared corpora. You can specify up to 10 **speech corpus identifiers**.

You can obtain the **speech corpus identifiers** on the **Task Details** page under **Shared Corpus Management** in the **Voice Broadcast Service** console
parameters.help_zh:
共享语料的**语料标识**列表，最多可传入10个**语料标识**。

您可在**千里传音语音播报服务**控制台的**分享语料管理**下**任务详情**页面，获取**语料标识**
parameters.name: speech_model_code_list
